comment: Thresholds for the ~100 MB images corpus. Same acceptance budgets as thresholds.json, except `open.rssDeltaMb`: bench-open MATERIALIZES the whole 100 MB corpus (the legacy path), which inherently holds several hundred MB of heap — the Ф1 'RSS <= 500 MB' budget belongs to the lazy open (resume capsule) path and is enforced there, not on the legacy materialization.
